caption: The drawing consists of five rectangular and square quilt block samples, each labeled with a letter (A, B, C, D, E) arranged in two rows on a plain, off-white background. Block A in the top left shows a pinwheel-like design with four triangular sections colored in green, yellow, red, and white with pink and black patterns. Block B in the top center features a white quilted background with two overlapping orange and yellow floral-patterned shapes at the top right. Block C in the top right has three triangles, two with blue and white patterns and one with a combination of yellow floral, red, and brown geometric patterns on a white quilted background. Block D in the bottom left displays diagonal bands of blue and black with floral details next to a pink patterned strip, bordered by quilted white areas. Block E in the bottom right shows white quilted space intersected by jagged orange, pink, and yellow patterned stripes with small floral motifs. Each block is neatly separated and drawn with colored pencil or similar medium. The name "Frances Law Burrard" is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the paper.
title: Woven Quilt Details
